query:
-- Estoque atual por galão (stock_liters está em centésimos ou inteiro?)
SELECT id, gallon_number, stock_liters, last_price_per_liter
FROM gallon_stock
ORDER BY gallon_number;

-- Compras por galão
SELECT gallon_number, SUM(liters_purchased) as total_comprado
FROM fuel_purchases
GROUP BY gallon_number
ORDER BY gallon_number;

-- Abastecimentos por galão (ativos - não excluídos)
SELECT gallon_number, SUM(liters) as total_usado, COUNT(*) as qtd
FROM fuel_records
WHERE payment_status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY gallon_number
ORDER BY gallon_number;
